traditional: 將 A 鋪喺 B 上面
jyutping: zoeng1 A pou1 hai2 B soeng6 min6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically laying or spreading one thing over another surface.

examples.english: We overlay the floor with a carpet.
examples.traditional: 我哋將地氈鋪喺地板上面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 dei6 zin1 pou1 hai2 dei6 baan2 soeng6 min6
